text: でんきの　けしわすれ　して　ないな

structure.jp: でんきの　けしわすれ
structure.en: forgetting to turn off the lights
I haven't done that, have I…

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus いない says something has not been done as things stand now; the い is dropped in casual speech. して ない = 'I haven't done it'.

patterns.name: 〜な (musing)
patterns.explanation: な at the end of a sentence shows the speaker is thinking aloud and checking with himself. して ないな = 'I haven't, have I…'
